name: fathom
label: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting assistant that automatically records, transcribes, highlights, and generates AI summaries and action items from your meetings. Integrate with workflows to react to meeting events and retrieve meeting data.

listMeetings.label: List Meetings
listMeetings.description: List meetings with optional filters. Follows every page unless you set Max Pages.

calendar_invitees.label: Calendar Invitees
calendar_invitees.description: Email addresses of calendar invitees to filter by. Fathom no longer documents this filter and may ignore it; prefer Calendar Invitees Domains or Recorded By.

calendar_invitees_domains.label: Calendar Invitees Domains
calendar_invitees_domains.description: Domains of the companies to filter by (e.g., acme.com)

calendar_invitees_domains_type.label: Calendar Invitees Domains Type
calendar_invitees_domains_type.description: Filter by whether calendar invitee list includes external email domains

recorded_by.label: Recorded By
recorded_by.description: Email addresses of users who recorded meetings

teams.label: Teams
teams.description: Team names to filter by (e.g., Sales, Engineering)

created_after.label: Created After
created_after.description: Filter to meetings created after this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

created_before.label: Created Before
created_before.description: Filter to meetings created before this timestamp (e.g., 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z)

include_transcript.label: Include Transcript
include_transcript.description: Include the transcript for each meeting. API key connections only; with OAuth use Get Recording Transcript.

include_summary.label: Include Summary
include_summary.description: Include the summary for each meeting. API key connections only; with OAuth use Get Recording Summary.

include_action_items.label: Include Action Items
include_action_items.description: Include the action items for each meeting

include_crm_matches.label: Include CRM Matches
include_crm_matches.description: Include CRM matches for each meeting

max_pages.label: Max Pages
max_pages.description: Stop after this many pages of meetings. Leave empty to fetch every page (each page holds about 10 meetings).
